n1.speaker: 朋友 Kate
n1.line: The weekend is coming! I am so excited. Do you have any plans for Saturday?
n1.lineCn: 周末就要来了!我好兴奋。你周六有什么打算吗?

grammar.name: will / be going to 的区分
grammar.note: be going to 表已有计划的打算,will 表临时决定或预测。

options.text: I am going to hike in the mountains with my family on Saturday. Do you want to come?
options.textCn: 我周六打算和家人去爬山,你想一起来吗?
options.feedback: 用 be going to 表达既定计划,还发出邀请。

options.text: I am going to sleep all day.
options.feedback: 计划太闷,周末白白浪费。
答非所问,与计划毫无关系。

n2.speaker: 朋友 Kate
n2.line: Hiking sounds fun! But wait, I just checked the weather. It is going to rain heavily on Saturday morning.
n2.lineCn: 爬山听起来不错!不过等等,我刚看了天气,周六上午会下大雨。

grammar.name: be going to 表预测
grammar.note: 根据现有迹象预测:It is going to rain,比 will 更有依据。

options.text: Oh no! If it is going to rain, I will change the hike to Sunday. What about you?
options.textCn: 糟糕!如果真要下雨,我就把爬山改到周日。你呢?
options.feedback: 用 be going to 预判天气,will 临时决定改期,运用得当。

options.text: It will not rain. The weather app is always wrong.
options.textCn: 不会下雨的,天气软件总是出错。
options.feedback: 无视天气预报,坚持原计划,容易被淋成落汤鸡。

n3.speaker: 朋友 Kate
n3.line: Hey, wake up! Let us think about the weekend together. What are you going to do if the weather is nice on Sunday?
n3.lineCn: 嘿,打起精神!我们一起想想周末吧。要是周日天气好,你打算做什么?

grammar.name: be going to 问计划
grammar.note: What are you going to do...? 询问已安排好的打算。

options.text: I am going to visit the new art museum if it is sunny. There is a special exhibition this week!
options.textCn: 如果天晴,我打算去新美术馆,这周有特别展览!
options.feedback: 结合天气用 be going to 给出具体安排。

options.text: I will decide when I wake up on Sunday.
options.feedback: 没有计划,没法和朋友安排活动。

n4.speaker: 朋友 Kate
n4.line: Good idea to move it to Sunday! According to the forecast, it will clear up on Sunday afternoon. The sun will be out after lunch.
n4.lineCn: 改到周日是好主意!天气预报说周日午后会转晴,午饭后太阳就出来了。

grammar.name: will 表客观预测
grammar.note: will + 动词原形用于较客观的天气预报,如 it will clear up。

options.text: Perfect! Then I am going to prepare the food tonight, and we will set off at 8 a.m. on Sunday.
options.textCn: 完美!那我今晚就准备吃的,我们周日早上八点出发。
options.feedback: be going to 表准备计划,will 表出发约定,安排明确。

options.text: Hmm, I will think about it later. Maybe I will not go at all.
options.textCn: 嗯,我晚点再想。也许我干脆不去了。

n5.speaker: 朋友 Kate
n5.line: Trust me, I have seen the radar. It is going to pour, not just rain lightly. We are going to get soaked if we go hiking on Saturday.
n5.lineCn: 相信我,我看过雷达了。那会是大暴雨,不是小雨。周六去爬山我们会全身湿透的。

grammar.name: be going to 表强烈迹象
grammar.note: 根据雷达等证据用 be going to 预测,比 will 更确定。

options.text: You are right. I will postpone it and check the forecast again tonight. Thanks for the warning!
options.textCn: 你说得对。我会推迟活动,今晚再看一遍预报。谢谢提醒!
options.feedback: 接受建议并用 will 表达临时调整,理性务实。

options.text: I do not care about the rain. I will go anyway.
options.textCn: 我不在乎下雨,我偏要去。
options.feedback: 一意孤行,大概率被雨淋。

n6.speaker: 朋友 Kate
n6.line: Deal! I will bring the umbrella just in case. Are you going to invite your brother too?
n6.lineCn: 说定了!以防万一我会带上伞。你打算也邀请你弟弟吗?

grammar.name: be going to 表意图
grammar.note: Are you going to...? 询问对方已打算好的安排。

options.text: Yes, I am going to ask him tonight. If he is free, he will join us. It is going to be a great trip!
options.textCn: 是的,我今晚就问他。要是他有空就会一起来。这趟肯定很棒!
options.feedback: 计划、条件、预测三种结构都用上了,周末安排确定。

options.text: I will not invite anyone. Just us, or nobody.
options.textCn: 我谁都不邀请,要么就我们俩,要么都不去。
options.feedback: 反复不定,朋友的心情都凉了半截。

success.speaker: 朋友 Kate
success.line: Wonderful! Sunday, 8 a.m., mountain hike. I am going to bring the sandwiches. See you then!
success.lineCn: 太棒了!周日早八点,爬山。我负责带三明治,到时见!

fail1.speaker: 朋友 Kate
fail1.line: Okay, but then do not complain later that the weekend was boring!
fail1.lineCn: 好吧,不过到时候可别抱怨周末无聊!

fail2.speaker: 朋友 Kate
fail2.line: Whatever you decide. I will just stay home and watch a movie then.
fail2.lineCn: 随你吧,那我就待在家看场电影。
